name: openrscad-release-root
description: Private root that drives changesets-based versioning for the whole repo. Never published; carries the canonical version that scripts/sync-versions.mjs propagates to Cargo, Tauri, and the npm package.
//overrides: @types/node is a types-only transitive dep; @manypkg/find-root pins ^12 while other tooling wants >=18, and npm writes a lockfile its own `npm ci` rejects. Collapse to one version so the lock stays self-consistent.
